parameters.name: contents[0].parts[0].text
parameters.value:
={{ "Analisis saham Indonesia berikut dengan gaya bahasa santai tapi profesional (gaya Jamet Stock Analyst):

Simbol: " + $json.symbol + "
Harga: Rp " + $json.price.toLocaleString('id-ID') + "
Volume: " + $json.volume.toLocaleString('id-ID') + "
Timeframe: " + $json.timeframe + "

Berikan analisis dalam format JSON berikut:
{
  "verdict": "BULLISH/BEARISH/TO THE MOON/BERDARAH/SIDEWAYS",
  "score": 0-100,
  "fundamental_score": 0-100,
  "technical_score": 0-100,
  "momentum_score": 0-100,
  "sentiment_score": 0-100,
  "risk_score": 0-100,
  "insight": "1-2 kalimat singkat tentang kondisi saham",
  "recommendation": "BUY/HOLD/SELL dengan alasan singkat"
}

Gunakan bahasa santai: cuan, gas, serok bawah, ATH, cut loss, dll. Jadilah spesifik dan realistis." }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  "chat_id": $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID,
  "text": "📊 *Analisis Saham Baru*

" +
         "🏢 *" + $node["Parse AI Response"].json.symbol + "* - " + $node["Parse AI Response"].json.name + "
" +
         "💰 Harga: Rp " + $node["Parse AI Response"].json.price.toLocaleString('id-ID') + "
" +
         "📈 Score: " + $node["Parse AI Response"].json.score + "/100
" +
         "🎯 Verdict: " + $node["Parse AI Response"].json.verdict + "

" +
         "💡 *Insight:*
" + $node["Parse AI Response"].json.insight + "

" +
         "✅ *Rekomendasi:*
" + $node["Parse AI Response"].json.recommendation,
  "parse_mode": "Markdown"
} }}
